description: This file is a report module for supplier quotation comparison in ERPNext, containing functions to fetch, process, and display supplier quotation data with filtering, grouping, and charting capabilities.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions string based on provided filters.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches supplier quotation data from the database based on filters and conditions.

methods.name: prepare_data
methods.description: Prepares and formats data for report display and charting, including currency conversion and grouping.

methods.name: prepare_chart_data
methods.description: Generates chart data for visual comparison of supplier prices across quantities.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the report columns, optionally reversing order based on grouping.

methods.name: get_message
methods.description: Returns an HTML string with status indicators for expiry dates.
